Good to know

Frequently Asked Questions

When is the wedding?

Saturday, 24 July 2027. The religious ceremony begins at 14:30.

Where will the wedding take place?

Both the religious ceremony and reception will be held at La Ferme Bertinchamps d’Ophain, Chemin Bertinchamps 51, 1421 Ophain (Braine-l’Alleud), Belgium. Get directions.

What is the schedule?

The ceremony starts at 14:30, followed by welcome drinks at 16:00, dinner and dancing. See the full schedule above.

Is there a dress code?

Dress code details will be announced later. The invitation colours reflect our wedding decorations.

How do I RSVP?

Please complete the RSVP form below. To collect your responses, the website must first be published with form submissions enabled.
